kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتمر (form VIII)
# نَعْتَمِرُ (naʕtamiru) /naʕ.ta.mi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# نُعْتَمَرُ (nuʕtamaru) /nuʕ.ta.ma.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# نَعْتَمِرَ (naʕtamira) /naʕ.ta.mi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# نُعْتَمَرَ (nuʕtamara) /nuʕ.ta.ma.ra/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
